hero.title: Get hired with an ATS
hero.subtitle: ATSResume is an innovative resume builder that helps job seekers create a professional and optimized resume for applicant tracking systems. Our platform uses cutting-edge technology to analyze and optimize your resume for maximum visibility and success. Say goodbye to manual formatting frustration and wasted time, and Create your winning resume with ATSResume today and get noticed by employers.

atsOptimized.title: ATS-optimized
atsOptimized.description: Our platform uses cutting-edge technology to analyze and optimize your resume for maximum visibility and success with applicant tracking systems.

easyToUse.title: Easy to use
easyToUse.description: Our user-friendly interface makes it easy to build a professional, ATS-friendly resume in minutes. No more frustration or wasted time spent on manual formatting.

free.title: Free
free.description: Our platform is completely free to use. No hidden fees or subscriptions. Just create an account and start building your dream resume today!

mobileFriendly.title: Mobile-friendly
mobileFriendly.description: Our platform is fully responsive and mobile-friendly, so you can build your resume on the go. No more waiting until you get home to work on your resume.

downloadBackup.title: Download Backup Data
downloadBackup.description: Download your resume data in JSON format and store it in a safe place. You can use this data to restore your resume in the future.

uploadBackup.title: Upload Backup Data
uploadBackup.description: Upload your resume data in JSON format to restore your resume. This is useful if you accidentally delete your resume or if you want to switch devices.
